ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the documentation cards. Formatted text and links are allowed.

SectionHeadingElement.helper: Choose the heading level that fits the page outline.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Access product specifications, integration guides, and implementation resources.

SectionAriaLabel.helper: Optional. Used only when no visible section heading is provided.

Documents.helper: Add documentation cards in display order. CTAs render only when button Text and the selected source resolve to a safe web addresses.

Description.helper: Optional. Short supporting description for this document.
Description.placeholder: Complete endpoint reference with authentication, payload examples, and response formats.

FileSource.helper: Choose whether this document links to a typed web addresses or a selected/uploaded file.

Url.helper: Allowed web addresses formats: anchors, slash-relative web addresses, http, https, mailto, and tel.

UploadFile.helper: Select or upload the real document file. Type and size are computed when OpenContent file metadata or a safe local file lookup is available.

FileTypeLabel.helper: web addresses mode only. Optional fallback when the web addresses has no file extension.

FileMeta.helper: web addresses mode only. Optional manual type and size fallback when the template cannot compute them from the web addresses.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

FooterLabel.helper: Optional. Small footer label shown before the button.

CtaText.helper: button link text. The button renders only when this and the selected source resolves to a safe web addresses.

LinkTarget.helper: Choose whether the button opens in the current tab or a new tab.

CtaAriaLabel.helper: Optional. More descriptive label for screen readers, especially when button text repeats across cards.
